slides.title: CHAPTER 2 · What Knowledge Management Means at Lenovo

units.en: At Lenovo, Enterprise Knowledge Management is more than an activity or process.
units.zh: 在联想，企业知识管理不只是一项活动或流程。

units.en: It is a strategic enterprise initiative | focused on transforming Lenovo into a leading Knowledge and AI-driven organization.
units.zh: 它是一项企业级战略举措，| 致力于将联想转型为领先的知识与 AI 驱动型组织。

units.en: Our goal is to create a trusted, scalable, and AI-ready knowledge ecosystem | that connects people, content, and intelligence across the enterprise.
units.zh: 我们的目标是打造一个可信、可扩展、AI 就绪的知识生态系统，| 在整个企业中连接人员、内容与智能。

source_text: At Lenovo, Enterprise Knowledge Management is more than an activity or process. It is a strategic enterprise initiative focused on transforming Lenovo into a leading Knowledge and AI-driven organization. Our goal is to create a trusted, scalable, and AI-ready knowledge ecosystem that connects people, content, and intelligence across the enterprise.
